Implemented the binary tree zipper in [zipper.py](/app/zipper.py).

Implemented operations:
- `from_tree`, `to_tree`
- `value`, `set_value`
- `left`, `right`
- `set_left`, `set_right`
- `up`

The zipper uses immutable-style breadcrumbs and deep copies so existing zipper instances and source trees remain unchanged.
